Implemented source-only compatibility for `lru-cache@9.0.0`.

Changed `src/get-jwks.js` to use the v9 named `LRUCache` export, updated public typings to reference `LRUCache`, and added a small source type shim so the unchanged existing type tests still accept the previous default-import cache type shape.

Validated with `npm run lint` and `npm test -- --no-coverage` against both the current lockfile install and a temporary local `lru-cache@9.0.0` install.
